$comment: Fragment for manifest.json slots — C-100…C-110 match pair icons (SET-C-MATCH, 48x48, 2px pine-950 line, clay-500 used once across the whole set, on match-body-position) and B-055…B-060 section arc marks (SET-B-SECTION, 20x20, 1.5px, stroke=currentColor with no hardcoded colour so StepRail and SectionInterstitial can tint them by todo/active/done state). Merge into manifest.json 'slots'; do not edit this file in place once merged.

match-thumb-throttle.alt: Thumb throttle: the hand stays closed around the grip while the thumb alone works a small lever on the bar.

match-front-brake.alt: Front brake: a hand lever hinged at a perch beside the grip and swept out in front of the handlebar.

match-rear-brake.alt: Rear brake: an over-the-ankle boot with its toe down on the foot pedal pad, the pedal arm swept back to its pivot.

match-stop-switch.alt: Engine stop switch: a proud rocker in a raised bezel, thrown to the side marked by a bold stop bar so it can be found by feel.

match-gear-selector.alt: Gear selector: a routed gate plate with the lever seated at the bottom of the deep leg, chevrons marking the low range.

match-body-position.alt: Body position, the invisible control: a helmeted rider standing on the footboards with weight moved forward over the bars, the direction of the lean marked in clay.

match-turnaround-time.alt: Turnaround time: a clock face above a U-turn arrow — the hour you head back, fixed before you leave.

match-off-ride-contact.alt: Off-ride contact: someone at home at a lit window with a phone, waiting on the check-in — a person who is not on the ride.

match-water-food.alt: Water and food beyond the plan: a part-full bottle beside a ration bar pushed up out of its wrapper.

match-nav.alt: Signal-free navigation: a folded paper map with a compass laid across its corner — neither needs a phone or a signal.

match-warmth.alt: Warmth for an unplanned wait: a quilted insulating layer folded down into a stack, collar showing.

section-briefing.alt: Briefing section: a trailhead post with its board pointing the way out.

section-learn.alt: Learn section: the field guide open on its spine.

section-try.alt: Try section: a boot sole pressed into the trail.

section-debrief.alt: Debrief section: a backward glance, the arc turning to look down the trail already ridden.

section-journal.alt: Journal section: a pen set to the ruled line.

section-checkpoint.alt: Checkpoint section: the trail blaze on its post, the mark you ride to.
